The [[Qua family]]'s '''villa''' was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Esseles/Legends|Esseles]]. Until [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the family's only heir, [[Dezono Qua]], lived alone in this villa with [[Droid/Legends|droids]] as his only companions. The villa was guarded by a small army of [[IG-series/Legends|IG-series]] droids, an [[H2]] [[Pilot droid/Legends|pilot droid]], and a [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] nicknamed "[[E-10]]."<ref name="DT5" />
